stones.calvino_stone: Not one city, but many cities of equal size and not unlike one another, scattered over a vast rolling plateau; only ONE is inhabited at any time while the other six stand empty, waiting.
stones.state_contract: SISTER_CITIES has length 7; getState().inhabitedCount === 1 and getState().emptyCount === 6 at all times; vacated city scrubs back to quicklime while target city ignites terracotta roofs and chimney smoke.

stones.calvino_stone: When the inhabitants feel the grip of weariness and no one can bear any longer his job, his relatives, his house and its street-view, his debts, the people he must greet or who greet him, the whole citizenry moves to the next empty city.
stones.state_contract: weariness accumulates across 5 vectors (job, relatives, house, debts, greetings) from 0.0 to 1.0; exodus streams ox-cart and mule caravan along winding chalk plateau roads to a chosen empty sister mesa and resets weariness.

stones.calvino_stone: Each inhabitant takes a new job, a different wife, sees another landscape on opening his window, and spends his time with different pastimes, friends, and gossip; within a lifetime a man rarely returns to a job that had already been his.
stones.state_contract: permuteForNewCity() applies fixed-point-free cyclic derangements across 8 citizens for job, wife, house, 12-grossi debt edge, and pastime/gossip (fixedPoints === 0, citizensChangedCount === 8, 8-step non-repeating lifetime job cycle) plus shifts windowVista to the active mesa.

inner_arch.description: Because Eutropia's society is ordered without great distinctions of wealth or authority, total individual permutation leaves the global social graph 100% unchanged: Eutropia shifts up and down on its empty chessboard repeating the exact same scenes with changed actors, the exact same speeches in rotated accents, and alternate mouths opening in identical wide-open yawns.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Interactive 2.5D Rolling-Plateau Chessboard Panorama & Mercury Permutation-Isomorphism Proof Ledger with 4-Voice Musical-Chair Canon WebAudio

guild_roster.name: eutropia-mesa-surveyor
guild_roster.role: 2.5D rolling plateau canvas of 7 hexagonal walled sister cities (1 active terracotta + smoke, 6 scrubbed quicklime empty), winding caravan exodus animation, casement window vista inset, and 4-voice musical-chair canon WebAudio.

guild_roster.name: eutropia-mercury-rotator
guild_roster.role: 5-vector civic weariness accumulator, 8-citizen fixed-point-free permutation matrix (job/wife/house/12-grossi-debt/gossip), 4 canonical piazza scenes, 3 rotated wide-open yawns, and live mathematical isomorphism proof under Mercury.

guild_roster.name: eutropia-weaver
guild_roster.role: Splices both layers inline into a 100% standalone index.html with bespoke <eutropia-*> DOM vocabulary, zero external/relative-parent URLs, 1280x800 & 390x844 zero-overflow responsive layout, keyboard/reduced-motion accessibility, and <eutropia-plate-drawer> [P] for map.png & image.png.

guild_roster.name: eutropia-critic
guild_roster.role: Blindfolded verifier auditing HG-1 (standalone & J_dom < 0.35), HG-2 (1280x800 & 390x844 viewports, zero errors, keyboard & reduced-motion), HG-3 (Calvino stones & Mercury isomorphism inner arch), and HG-4 (map.png 1600x1200, map.svg, image.png 1600x1000 on disk & rendered in <eutropia-plate-drawer>).

hard_gates.HG-1: 100% standalone index.html: literal 0 occurrences of http://, https://, or ../; all 5 chartered custom tags present; 0 generic layout tags in body; 100% .eutropia-* CSS classes; J_dom < 0.35.
hard_gates.HG-2: Playwright verified at 1280x800 and 390x844: scrollWidth <= innerWidth, scrollHeight <= innerHeight, 0 console/page errors, interactive canvas + controls unobstructed, keyboard shortcuts & prefers-reduced-motion supported.
hard_gates.HG-3: Causal fidelity: 7 plateau cities with strictly 1 inhabited & 6 empty; weariness rises across 5 burdens & resets on exodus; every migration permutes 8/8 citizens with 0 fixed points across job/wife/house/debt/gossip while global scene signature SCENES:4|JOBS:8|DEBTS:8x12g|YAWNS:3 and wealthGini=0.0 remain 100% invariant.
hard_gates.HG-4: Royal plates map.png (1600x1200), map.svg, and image.png (1600x1000) present on disk and cleanly inspectable in <eutropia-plate-drawer> ([P] toggle, [Z] zoom, [Escape] close) with naturalWidth > 0.
